features.featureTitle: In the 'Catat Distribusi' (Record Distribution) page, replace the free-text beneficiary name input with a searchable checklist selector that pulls data from the existing Sasaran (beneficiary) records. The checklist must group beneficiaries by village (desa), allowing the inputter to expand each village group and check/uncheck individual beneficiaries. Multiple beneficiaries can be selected at once before submitting the distribution record.
